question: Does a bounded spatial-plus-source-luminance color gain field provide held-block representation capacity beyond a parameter-matched global RGB LUT on paired FiveK digital-retouch controls?

research_basis.paper: Guan et al., FastGaMer: Efficient GainMap Learning for Practical Inverse Tone Mapping, CVPR 2026
research_basis.borrowed_idea_only: separate spatially varying local adaptation from global colour mapping and execute the high-resolution result through an explicit bounded gain field
research_basis.clean_room_difference: no paper code, weights or data; no HDR reconstruction, neural predictor, dynamic grid generator, learned LUT or absolute luminance estimation

population.row_selection: lexicographically first pair_id within each of the exact 24 development camera_model groups
population.role: paired digital-retouch representation-capacity control; not film or stock evidence

candidate.source_guidance: within-image stable midrank of linear-sRGB luminance
candidate.application: trilinear interpolation followed by one analytical per-pixel dose along the log-gain direction

parameter_matched_global_rgb_lut.family: strict-interior trilinear residual LUT fitted on the same non-held pixels

evaluation.style_retention: candidate held-pixel RMSE from source divided by target held-pixel RMSE from source

branch_rules.all_gates_pass: retain the explicit representation and open one separately frozen group-held source-only predictor or hard sparse coefficient route
branch_rules.any_gate_fails: close this exact spatial-gain representation without grid, regularization, split, target, population, metric or threshold rescue
branch_rules.visual_review: forbidden in this target-informed representation-capacity leaf

claim_ceiling: development-only held-block representation-capacity evidence for one explicit bounded spatial gain field on paired FiveK digital-retouch controls; not a deployable predictor, film response, stock identity, calibration, preference or product result
